data.title: Jobcenter invitation for 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a meeting on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 in room 1.18 with Ms Petzold to discuss her current job situation. Missing it without good reason cuts benefits by 10%.
data.explanation: This is a formal summons (Meldeaufforderung) from the Jobcenter. Go to room 1.18 at the Jobcenter on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you miss the appointment without an important reason, your Bürgergeld is reduced by 10 percent of the standard rate (Regelbedarf) for one month. If you cannot attend, for example because of illness, contact the Jobcenter before the date and give the reason. Keep proof such as a medical certificate.
